newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SUMMARIES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUMMARIES IN THE SPANISH FIRST DIVISION.

text.p: Summaries of games played in the Spanish first division on Sunday:
Logrones 0 Celta 3 (Vladimir Gudelj 57th, 75th, Geli de Juana 68th). Halftime 0-0. Attendance 11,000.
Sporting Gijon 2 (Sergio 10th, Julio Salinas 83rd) Athletic Bilbao 4 (Ismael Urzaiz 6th, Julen Guerrero 57th, Jose Ziganda 70th, 78th). 1-1. 16,000.
Zaragoza 2 (Dani Garcia 34th, 82nd) Real Betis 2 (Alexis Trujillo 47th, 85th pen). 1-0. 19,000.
Real Sociedad 3 (Darko Kovacevic 32nd, Gheorghe Craioveanu 34th, Ramon De Quintana 55th own goal) Rayo Vallecano 1 (Ramon De Quintana 40th). 2-1. 18,000.
Sevilla 1 (Salva Ballesta 54th) Real Madrid 3 (Predrag Mijatovic 19th, 61st, Davor Suker 29th). 0-2. 57,000.
